model.description: DeepSeek model id. deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner are legacy aliases (deprecating 2026-07-24). Free text accepted for new/custom models. Left blank until live discovery selects the cheapest available model.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level. Only applies to models that support thinking (e.g. deepseek-v4-pro). 'disabled' turns off thinking mode.

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: Experimental — enabling this is experimental and may change. Request a JSON response via DeepSeek's native JSON mode (response_format json_object). Constrains the reply to valid JSON so malformed output is far less likely (DeepSeek does not enforce a strict schema). Off by default — enable only if you see 'malformed JSON from provider' errors.
